title: The Debt of Geneva
author: Bram Ravensworth
blurb: Lena Hartwell, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
